goal: Prove broad public crypto-universe discovery, Spot/Futures separation, strategy compatibility, frozen Quiet-RV evaluation, risk/evidence gating, honest current paper action or no-trade, and one clearly-labelled historical lifecycle replay for entry->exit->statistics plumbing.
anti_tuning: Quiet-RV parameters are copied unchanged from SL-VAL-QUIET-RV-001 / portability lineage: 8 assets, 4h, 42/540/30% quiet-vol gate, 42/540/90% deviation trigger, 6-bar hold, 6-bar decluster, 10bps cost. No asset/rule/threshold/holding/cost tuning. Universe discovery is venue-derived, not a handpicked scanner universe.
current_market_rule: Evaluate only the latest fully closed common 4h bar. If no frozen signal exists, record NO-SIGNAL. If a signal exists, queue PAPER-ENTRY for next-bar-open and never fabricate an unobserved fill.
historical_replay_rule: Use the latest already-completed frozen event inside the freshly acquired public dataset solely to prove lifecycle accounting; mark it HISTORICAL-LIFECYCLE-REPLAY / NOT CURRENT TRADE.
persistence_semantics: Artifact must prove full-universe coverage with counts/hashes, preserve material states and reasons, and compact repetitive unchanged per-symbol no-signal states rather than emitting one durable row per symbol per cycle.
limitations: This first bounded E2E is a research harness proof, not the final persistent production scanner. Quiet-RV venue-price portability does not imply funding/OI/execution portability, and Futures must fail closed unless a separately frozen compatible paper strategy version exists.
